div.head: V Atr 34
div.ab: Ealle we scylan ænne God lufian ⁊ weorðian ⁊ ælcne hæðendom mid ealle aweorpan.
Ealle we sculan ænne God lufigian ⁊ weorðian ⁊ ænne Cristendom georne healdan ⁊ ælcne hæþendom mid ealle aweorpan.
Ealle we sculon ænne God lufian ⁊ wurðian ⁊ ænne Cristendom georne healdan ⁊ ælcne hæðendom mid ealle awurpan.
It is the duty of us all to love and honour one God, and zealously uphold one Christian faith, and wholly renounce all heathen practices.
Alle sollen wir Einen Gott lieben und ehren (und eifrig Ein Christenthum halten G2 D) und jedes Heidenthum gänzlich verwerfen.
We must all love and honour one God (and eagerly hold one Christian faith, G2 D) and utterly reject all heathenism.
div.note: The archetype added ‘⁊ ænne Cristendom georne healdan’ (as G2, D and 1 above). Liebermann compares EGu Prol. 1.
